summary: Add optional canonical defaultColor metadata 0xf8fafc to all six migrated counter-top Items without making defaultColor mandatory or changing renderer override behavior.

impactAnalysis.notes: All six counter-top Items share the existing rendered default color 0xf8fafc as optional product metadata. The field is not introduced as a mandatory Item schema field; Items without a product default color may omit it. Renderer-specific colors and overrides remain independent and unchanged.

e2e.reason: Production Item metadata is BOM-domain data; existing browser module-construction coverage is retained while the new unit regression locks optional defaultColor semantics.

risk.notes: Metadata-only addition to six already canonical counter-top Items. Dimensions, quantities, recipes, state, persistence and renderer code are unchanged.

migration.notes: No persisted project or recipe migration is required; defaultColor is optional canonical product metadata.

rollback: Remove defaultColor from the six counter-top production Item records and remove the dedicated regression; no persisted data rollback is required.
